name: Sandy the Witch
original_name: サンディ・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
Sandy is an executioner, mercilessly hunting down her own kind (witches). A formidable bisexual sadist, she is unmatched in combat prowess and savagery.

Her weapon of choice is a pair of serrated, viciously shaped swords. Sandy revels in the act of tearing her still-living victims apart, using her intertwined jagged blades to cleave their torsos in two.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url]]
